tools.name: list_tracked_products
tools.description: Lists the products the account tracks, with their collection state (collected, stale, withdrawn, unavailable, pending, failed), the marketplace they come from and the last known price. Paginated with a cursor; at most 100 per page.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Returns the subscription state, the plan capabilities and limits, the number of tracked products, the default line mode and the permissions granted to Claude.

tools.name: list_price_positions
tools.description: Returns the account-wide price position summary (buy box, top 1 to 3 counts, average rank and gap to the best price) and the tracked products that need attention, each with a status: losing, leading, alone or unknown. Paginated by page; at most 50 per page.

tools.name: get_product_offers
tools.description: Returns the current offers of one tracked product, cheapest first, with the seller, the marketplace, the price, the shipping price and whether the offer holds the buy box. At most 50 offers; `productId` must come from list_tracked_products.

tools.name: get_product_price_history
tools.description: Returns one entry per day for a tracked product over the requested window (1 to 90 days, 30 by default): rank, gap to the best price, offer count and the offers that changed that day. Days beyond the plan retention come back locked. Optional `channelId` restricts to one marketplace.

tools.name: list_recommended_prices
tools.description: Lists the prices Sweeprice currently recommends for the tracked products whose line mode produces one, per marketplace, with the basis of each recommendation. Optional `productId` filter. Paginated with a cursor; at most 100 per page.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Lists the price alerts raised for the account, newest first: product, marketplace, previous and new price, previous and new rank, status (unread, read, resolved). Optional `status` and `productId` filters. Paginated by page; at most 100 per page.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Lists the account notifications, newest first: undercut, buy box won, price drop, price rise, first collection and action needed, each with the product and the figures behind it. `unreadOnly` keeps the unread ones. Paginated with a cursor; at most 50 per page.

tools.name: add_tracked_product
tools.description: Adds a product to the tracked list from a marketplace product URL or from a GTIN (EAN/UPC), exactly one of the two, and starts collecting its offers. Adding a product already tracked changes nothing. Counts against the plan limit of tracked products.

tools.name: set_product_line_mode
tools.description: Sets what Sweeprice does with the prices of one tracked product: alert_only (watch and alert), repricing (recommend a price against the same marketplace), cross_marketplace (against every marketplace, Pro plan and up) or discovery (find the price buyers accept for a product with no direct competitor

tools.name: set_product_price_bounds
tools.description: Sets the floor price and/or the ceiling price of one tracked product, the bounds no recommended price ever crosses. Pass null to clear a bound. At least one of the two must be given; the floor cannot exceed the ceiling.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Marks the given notifications as read, by id (1 to 100 ids from list_notifications). Notifications of kind action_needed stay unread until the situation is handled.
